DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 紙幣について、どのようなご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like regarding the banknotes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お祝い用に、きれいな紙幣を用意したいです。五枚あればよいと思っていましたが、金額も決めて伝える必要がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 祝いのきれいな紙幣を五枚と考えたが合計額も伝える必要に気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like clean banknotes for a celebration. I thought five notes would be enough, but I also need to decide and tell you the amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you were thinking of five clean notes for a celebration but realized you also need to state the total amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望の合計額と、紙幣の種類を教えてください。取扱いの条件は担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the total amount and denominations you would like. The staff member will check the handling conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 合計五千円です。千円札を五枚にしたいです。五千円札を五枚という意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五千円札五枚ではなく合計五千円を千円札五枚と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The total is 5,000 yen. I would like five 1,000-yen notes. I do not mean five 5,000-yen notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want a total of 5,000 yen in five 1,000-yen notes, not five 5,000-yen notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 合計五千円で、千円札五枚のご希望ですね。交換の可否と条件をご案内してから進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You would like a total of 5,000 yen in five 1,000-yen notes. We will explain whether exchange is possible and the conditions before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。紙幣がきれいなら金額はどれでもよい、ということではありません。贈る金額は変えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙幣の見た目を希望しても贈る総額は変えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I do not mean that any amount is fine as long as the notes are clean. I will not change the amount I am giving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that although you have a preference about the notes' appearance, you will not change the total gift amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙幣の状態やご用意について、ご希望どおりになるかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also check whether we can meet your wishes regarding the notes' condition and availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。今ある物を見せてもらえるとは決めず、取扱いと条件を聞いてから、今日お願いするか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交換可否や条件を聞いてから当日の依頼を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I will not assume you can show me what is available now. I will hear about handling and conditions before deciding whether to request it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will decide whether to request the exchange today after hearing whether it is possible and what the conditions are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望の確認までで、まだ交換は行っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have only confirmed your wishes; no exchange has taken place yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。合計五千円、千円札五枚という希望をメモに書きました。条件を確認してから進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 総額と紙幣種類と枚数をメモで示し確認後に進めたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I wrote down that I want a total of 5,000 yen in five 1,000-yen notes. I would like to proceed after checking the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your note stating the total, denomination, and number of notes, and say in Japanese that you want to proceed after confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当へおつなぎします。それでは、案内をお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass that information to the staff member. Please wait for assistance. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 売場の台の下に、何か落とされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you drop something under the display stand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の携帯が手から滑って入りました。台を動かせば取れそうですが、自分で動かす前にお尋ねしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯が台下へ落ち自分で台を動かす前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My phone slipped out of my hand and went underneath. It looks as though moving the stand would let me get it, but I want to ask before moving it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your phone fell under the stand and you are asking before moving the stand yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 台は動かさず、係へご相談ください。どの辺りに見えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please leave the stand where it is and ask a staff member. Where can you see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手前の脚の後ろです。黒いストラップが見えます。手を伸ばすだけでは届かないので、無理に引き出してはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 台脚の後ろの黒いストラップを示し無理に引き出していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Behind the leg nearest me. I can see the black strap. I cannot reach it simply by stretching out my hand, so I have not tried to force it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the black strap behind the stand's leg and explain in Japanese that you have not tried to force the phone out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 係が場所を確認します。通路を空けて、こちら側でお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will check the location. Could you keep the aisle clear and wait on this side?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、こちらへ移ります。携帯を取るために買物かごを通路へ置いたままにせず、自分で持って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: かごも持ち通路を空け指定された場所で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I will move over here. I will hold my shopping basket while I wait instead of leaving it in the aisle to retrieve my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take your basket, keep the aisle clear, and wait in the designated place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 黒いストラップ以外に、分かる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there any identifying features besides the black strap?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青いケースです。係の方が見つけても、似た色というだけで自分の物だと決めず、確認してから受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青いケースを説明し似た色だけで本人品とせず確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It has a blue case. Even if the staff member finds one, I will not decide it is mine just because the color is similar. I will check before accepting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the blue case and say in Japanese that you will check ownership rather than rely only on a similar color.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 係が取り出したのは、こちらの携帯です。ご自身の物かご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the phone the staff member retrieved. Please check whether it is yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 青いケースと、自分で付けたストラップの模様が合っています。私の携帯です。台を動かさず相談してよかったです。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ケースとストラップ模様で本人品と確認し相談への感謝を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The blue case and the pattern on the strap I attached match. This is my phone. I am glad I asked instead of moving the stand. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm ownership using the case and strap pattern and thank them for their help in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人の携帯と確認できましたね。それでは、お買物をお続けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed that it is your phone. Please continue your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鳥の案内をご覧になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the bird information, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内の鳥を見たいです。この場所で待てば、すぐ現れるのでしょうか。まだ一羽も見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内の鳥がすぐ現れるかまだ見えないと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to see the bird described here. If I wait here, will it appear soon? I have not seen a single one yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the bird described will appear soon, explaining that you have not seen it yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 鳥が現れる時刻はお約束できません。ご覧になりたいのは姿でしょうか、声でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot promise when a bird will appear. Would you like to see it or hear its call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず姿を見たかったです。でも、待っている間に小さな声は聞こえました。それが案内の鳥かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 姿を見たいが小声を聞き鳥の種類は不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wanted to see it first. But while waiting, I heard a faint call. I do not know whether it was the bird described here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to see it, but have heard a faint call and do not know the bird's species.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分からない声は、種名を決めずに記録する方法もあります。周囲を静かにご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also record an unfamiliar call without assigning it a species name. Please observe your surroundings quietly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。「鳥は見えなかったが、短い声が聞こえた」とメモします。見えなかった時間も、何もできなかったとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 種名を決めず見えなかった事と声を記録すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. I will note, “I did not see the bird, but I heard a short call.” I will try not to think that time without seeing it was time in which I accomplished nothing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record not seeing the bird and hearing its call without identifying a species.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どのくらい過ごすかは、ご自身の予定に合わせてお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please decide how long to stay according to your own schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もう少し静かに見てから帰ります。声がした場所へ急いで入り込まず、この場所から周りを見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 少し待って帰り音源へ入り込まず同じ場所から観察すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will watch quietly a little longer before going home. I will not rush into the place the call came from; I will observe the surroundings from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait a little before leaving and observe from the same place without entering the area the sound came from.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 足元や通行にも気を付けて、観察をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please enjoy observing while taking care of your footing and other people passing by.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は姿を見られなくても、聞こえた声と周囲の様子を自分の記録に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 姿が見えなくても声と周囲の記録を残すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Even if I do not see the bird today, I will keep my own record of the call I heard and the surroundings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that even without seeing the bird, you will record the call and the surroundings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、よい観察の時間をお過ごしください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Have a good time observing. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運休の案内について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the cancellation notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗るつもりだった便が運休とあります。今日、目的地へ行く方法はもう何もないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予定便の運休で他の移動方法もないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says the service I planned to take is cancelled. Does that mean there is no way at all to reach my destination today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether there are any other ways to travel after your planned service was cancelled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予定されていた便と、ほかの移動方法は分けて確認しましょう。目的地と、ご予定を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check your planned service separately from other ways to travel. Please tell me your destination and plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 親戚の家へ荷物を届けます。親戚には、今日中なら着く時刻は決まっていないと話しています。急いで同じ時刻へ着く必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 親戚へ荷物を届ける用件と到着時刻に余裕があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am delivering a package to a relative's home. I told them there is no fixed arrival time as long as it is today. I do not need to hurry to arrive at the original time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are delivering a package to a relative and have flexibility in your arrival time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 代わりの案内ができるか確認します。最初の便の予約や切符もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check whether we can suggest an alternative. Do you also have the reservation or ticket for the original service?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。代案が見つかる前に、自分で別の券を買ってしまうのは待ちます。今の券の扱いも一緒に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元の券を示し別券購入前に代案と券の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. I will hold off buying another ticket myself before an alternative is found. I would also like to ask what happens to my current ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the original ticket and ask in Japanese about alternatives and how it will be handled before buying another ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が確認してご案内します。まだ移動できると確定したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check and advise you. It has not yet been confirmed that you can travel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。親戚には、予定便が運休で案内を確認中だと伝えます。行けないと決まったとも、別の便に乗れたとも言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認中で移動の成否を断定せず親戚へ状況を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I will tell my relative that the planned service is cancelled and I am checking the information. I will say neither that I definitely cannot go nor that I have boarded another service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your relative the situation is being checked without asserting whether travel is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内を聞いた後に、今後のご予定をお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please decide your plans after hearing the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。届ける用件と時間の余裕を伝えられたので、移動方法と切符の扱いを確認してから連絡し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用件と時間条件に合う案内を聞いて予定を連絡し直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. Now that I have explained the purpose and my flexible timing, I will contact them again after checking the transport options and ticket handling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will hear the options suited to your purpose and timing, then contact them again with your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容でお調べします。それでは、こちらで案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check on that basis. Please wait here for assistance. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 日本語の学習情報をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for information about learning Japanese?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。普段の会話はできますが、職場でもらう紙を読むのが苦手です。話せるなら教室は必要ないと思われるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会話はできるが職場文書が読みにくく支援不要と思われる不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I can manage everyday conversation, but I struggle to read papers I receive at work. I worry people may think I do not need classes because I can speak.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you can converse but find workplace documents difficult to read and worry people will think you do not need support.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会話と読むことでは、ご希望が違うのですね。どのような紙を読みたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So your needs differ between conversation and reading. What kinds of papers would you like to read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 連絡の期限や、作業前の注意が書かれた文書です。文字は一つずつ読めても、文全体の意味で迷います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 期限や注意の文全体の理解で迷うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Documents containing deadlines for responding and precautions before work. Even if I can read the characters individually, I am unsure about the meaning of the whole sentence.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you struggle to understand complete sentences about deadlines and precautions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 学習相談の担当へ、そのご希望を伝えられます。実際の教室内容は担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I can convey your wishes to the learning consultation staff. They will explain the actual class content.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。職場の用紙を全部代わりに書いてもらいたいのではなく、自分で読む練習をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用紙の代筆ではなく自分で読む練習を希望と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I do not want someone to fill out all my workplace forms for me. I want to practice reading them myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want practice reading independently, rather than someone filling out your forms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談用には、個人情報を含まない例を用意できると、ご希望を説明しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: For the consultation, preparing an example without personal information would make it easier to explain your needs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうします。会社の人の名前や内部の情報は出さず、どんな言い回しで迷うかを自分のメモで示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個人情報や内部資料を出さず難しい言い回しの例を用意すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. I will not disclose coworkers' names or internal information. I will use my own notes to show which expressions confuse me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will prepare examples of difficult expressions without disclosing personal information or internal documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ、文を読む練習について相談したいと引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the staff member you want to discuss practicing reading sentences.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。話せることと、まだ読みにくいことを分けて説明し、教室の内容を聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会話と読解の力を分けて教室内容を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will explain separately what I can say and what I still find hard to read, and ask about the classes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish your conversational and reading abilities when discussing the class content.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望でご案内します。それでは、学習の相談にお役立てください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will guide you on that basis. I hope this helps with your learning consultation. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 食欲について、こちらに「ない」と書かれていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have written “none” here for appetite.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも、食べたくないというより、仕事中に食事の時間を取れないことが多いです。言い方が違ったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食欲がないというより勤務中に食事時間が取れないと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But rather than not wanting to eat, I often cannot make time for meals while working. Perhaps I phrased it incorrectly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct your statement in Japanese: rather than lacking appetite, you cannot find time to eat at work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空腹は感じますか。時間がある時に食べた様子も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you feel hungry? Please also tell us about eating when you have time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 空腹は感じます。休みの日には食事をしました。ただ、仕事の日は食べる機会が少なく、量が減っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空腹感と休日の食事と勤務日の量の減少を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do feel hungry. I ate meals on my days off. But on workdays I have fewer opportunities to eat, and the amount I eat has decreased.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your hunger, meals on days off, and reduced amount eaten on workdays.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを診療担当へ伝えます。量が減った期間は、分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the clinician about that distinction. Do you know how long you have been eating less?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここ一週間です。忙しいせいだと自分で決めず、食事の時刻と量のメモを見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期間一週間を述べ仕事を原因と断定せず食事記録を示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: For the past week. Rather than decide myself that being busy is the cause, I would like to show my notes of meal times and amounts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the one-week period and say in Japanese that you want to show meal records without assuming work is the cause.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メモをお持ちでしたら、担当へお渡しください。食べた後のご様子も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you have the notes, please give them to the clinician. We will also ask how you feel after eating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。思い出せない食事は空欄にしました。食べたのに書き忘れたのか、本当に食べなかったのか、分からない所も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記録の空欄が未摂食か未記入か不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I left blank the meals I cannot remember. I will also explain where I do not know whether I ate and forgot to write it down or really did not eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you do not know whether blanks in the record mean missed meals or missing entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かることと不明なことを、そのまま教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell us exactly what you know and what you do not know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。食欲がないとまとめず、空腹はあることと勤務中の食事機会が減ったことを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 空腹はあることと食事機会減少を診療者へ分けて伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. Instead of summing it up as a lack of appetite, I will explain that I feel hungry and have fewer chances to eat during work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell the clinician separately about feeling hungry and having fewer opportunities to eat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を引き継ぎます。それでは、診療担当の案内をお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass that information on. Please wait for the clinician's instructions. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車について、どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss about a bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に貸した自転車が戻りません。私は貸したつもりですが、相手はもらった物だとメッセージに書いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貸した自転車が戻らず相手は贈物と書いたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bicycle I lent to a friend has not come back. I intended it as a loan, but they wrote in a message that it was a gift.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your lent bicycle has not been returned and the other person wrote that it was a gift.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貸した時のやり取りは、どのように残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What records do you have of the exchange when you lent it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初は口頭でした。「今日使っていい」と言いましたが、返す日をはっきり決めていません。後のメッセージは残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 口頭で今日使ってよいと言い返却日未設定で後の文面はあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At first it was verbal. I said, “You can use it today,” but did not clearly agree on a return date. I still have the later messages.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you verbally allowed use that day, did not set a return date, and have the later messages.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の説明と、相手の文面を分けて確認しましょう。文面にないことを付け足さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us consider your account separately from their messages. Please do not add anything that is not in the messages.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。貸すと言った自分の記憶と、相手が贈られたと書いた文を、そのまま示します。相手も貸し物だと認めたとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己の記憶と相手の文を分け認めていない合意を補わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will show my memory of saying it was a loan and their message saying it was given to them, as they are. I cannot say they also admitted it was borrowed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish your memory from their words and will not add an agreement they have not acknowledged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が詳しい事情を伺います。今、自転車を無理に取り戻しに行くご予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will ask about the details. Are you currently planning to go and forcibly take the bicycle back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 考えていましたが、一人で押しかける前に相談したいです。ここで話せば、すぐ自転車が戻ると決まるわけでもありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 強引な回収前に相談し即時返却を保証されると考えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was considering it, but I want advice before going there alone uninvited. Talking here does not guarantee that the bicycle will come back immediately, either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want advice before forcibly retrieving it and do not assume an immediate return is guaranteed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今後の対応は、事情を確認して担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain what to do next after checking the circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。貸した時の言葉、返す日の未確認、相手の文面を整理して、担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当初の言葉と未設定期限と相手の文を担当へ整理して示すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will organize what I said when lending it, the unconfirmed return date, and their messages, and consult the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will organize your original words, the unset deadline, and their messages to present to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を引き継ぎます。それでは、担当の案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass that on. Please wait for the staff member's guidance. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお荷物をお送りになるご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about sending this package.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 服を小さく圧縮しました。見た目が半分くらいになったので、重さも送料も半分だと思ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 衣類圧縮で重さと送料も半分になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I compressed some clothes. They look about half as big now, so can I assume their weight and the shipping cost are also halved?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether compressing clothes also halves their weight and shipping cost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見た目だけでは料金を決められません。お送りになる状態で、大きさや重さを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot determine the price from appearance alone. We will check the size and weight in the condition in which you will send it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。服の枚数は変えていません。小さくなったことを、軽くなったことと同じに考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 枚数は変わらず体積減少を軽量化と同一視したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Of course. I have not changed the number of garments. I was treating becoming smaller as the same as becoming lighter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the number of garments is unchanged and you confused reduced volume with reduced weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外側の包みは、まだ準備中でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are you still preparing the outer packaging?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、今は中の袋だけです。外側も整えてから確認していただきます。空の袋だけ量っても、送る物の重さにはなりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外装未準備で完成後に測り空袋の重さを使わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, it is just the inner bag now. I will complete the outer packaging before having it checked. Weighing only an empty bag would not give the weight of what I am sending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the outer packaging is not ready, you will measure after completing it, and you will not use the empty bag's weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 梱包した状態でお持ちください。その条件で、利用できる方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please bring it in packaged. We will explain the available methods based on that condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。袋が戻って膨らむこともあるので、今の小さい形だけを約束するような書き方はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋が膨らむ可能性があり今の形を確定条件としないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. The bag may expand again, so I will not describe its present small shape as though I can guarantee it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the bag may expand and you will not treat its current shape as a fixed condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発送する時の状態を確認してから、方法と料金をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check its condition when sending it before choosing the method and price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。今日は包みを整え、完成後の大きさと重さで相談します。圧縮した見た目だけで金額を決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 完成梱包の大きさと重さで相談し見た目から料金を決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. Today I will finish the packaging, then ask based on the completed size and weight. I will avoid deciding the price from its compressed appearance alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consult based on the finished package's size and weight rather than determine the charge by appearance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、ご準備後にお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it in once it is ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日は、どのような口座のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss about your account today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 退職したので、給料を受け取っていた口座も今日閉じなければと思って来ました。まだ最後の入金があるか確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退職で口座も即日閉じる必要を感じたが最終入金未確認と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my job, so I came thinking I must close the account that received my salary today too. I have not checked whether there will still be a final deposit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that leaving your job made you feel you had to close the account immediately, but you have not checked the final deposit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 退職のことと口座の取扱いは、分けて確認しましょう。会社から最後の支払いの案内はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check leaving your job separately from how to handle the account. Did the company give you information about the final payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 金額の話はありましたが、いつどこへ入るかは聞いていません。この口座をもう使わないと、自分で決めただけでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 支払額の話だけで時期と入金先は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: We discussed the amount, but I have not asked when or where it will be deposited. I had simply decided myself that I would no longer use this account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that only the amount was discussed and the timing and destination remain unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 未確認の入金については会社へお尋ねください。口座の取扱いについては、こちらで必要な確認をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please ask the company about the unconfirmed deposit. We will explain the checks needed for handling the account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。会社へ口座を閉じたと先に伝えず、最後の支払い先と時期を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 口座閉鎖を先に知らせず会社へ支払先と時期を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I will check where and when the final payment will be made rather than first telling the company I have closed the account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the payment destination and timing with the company before reporting an account closure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに、この口座で続いている支払いやご利用について、把握されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know about any other ongoing payments or uses of this account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 全部は分かりません。給料だけの口座と思っていたので、記録を見て自分の利用を整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他利用が不明で記録から利用状況を整理したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not know all of them. I thought it was only for my salary, so I would like to look at the records and organize my account usage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that other uses are unclear and you want to review the records to organize your usage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した情報をそろえて、取扱いをご相談ください。本日はご相談の段階ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please gather the confirmed information and consult us about handling the account. Today is only a consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日すぐ閉じる依頼はせず、入金予定と利用状況を確認してから、必要な手続きを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日閉鎖は依頼せず予定と利用状況を確認後に手続きを聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not request immediate closure today. I will check expected deposits and account usage before asking what procedures are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not request closure today and will ask about procedures after checking expected deposits and usage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのご希望で承りました。それでは、確認に必要な案内をお渡しします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will give you the information needed to check. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの品をご覧ですか。試食もご用意しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at this product? We also have samples.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。でも今は食べたくないので、試食は遠慮します。断ったら、商品についても聞けなくなるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今は食べず試食を断るが商品質問もできなくなるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. But I do not want to eat now, so I will decline the sample. If I decline, will I no longer be able to ask about the product either?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can still ask about the product after declining a sample because you do not want to eat now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 試食をなさらなくても、ご質問は伺えます。何を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can ask questions even without tasting it. What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家で家族と食べる時の量です。空腹ではないだけなので、商品が嫌いだと言ったつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族と食べる量を知り商品嫌いではなく空腹でないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The amount for eating at home with my family. I am simply not hungry; I did not mean that I dislike the product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to know the amount for your family and are not hungry, rather than disliking the product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容量の表示はこちらです。ご家族の人数に合わせて比べていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The net quantity is shown here. You can compare it according to the number of people in your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見ます。試食を断るために、実際にはないアレルギーを理由にする必要はありませんね。今は食べないという希望だけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内容量を見て架空のアレルギー理由を作らず希望を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will look. There is no need to invent an allergy I do not have to decline a sample. I will simply say I do not want to eat now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will look at the quantity and state your preference without inventing an allergy as a reason.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご希望で承りました。ほかの大きさの商品もご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. You can also look at products in other sizes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの小さい品を比べたいです。味を試していないことはそのままにして、量と包装を確認して考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 味見していない事実を残し小さい品の量と包装を比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to compare this smaller one. I will keep in mind that I have not tasted it and consider the quantity and packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to compare the smaller product's quantity and packaging while acknowledging you have not tasted it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望の品を、こちらでご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at the product you are interested in here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は表示を見て検討します。試食をしなかった分、必ず買わなければとも思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示で検討し試食の断りが購入義務とも考えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Today I will consider it by looking at the label. I will try not to think I must buy it because I declined the sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consider the label and will not treat declining a sample as an obligation to buy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、ご自身のご予定に合わせてお選びください。それでは、ごゆっくりご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please choose according to your own plans. Take your time looking.
